protocol: Explicit layerwise parameter metadata map for the v12 single-factor table
notes: The raw layerwise table records analysis factor, layer number, varied X value, width and height; this file makes the factor-to-full-parameter mapping explicit for model supervision.
For each single-factor sweep, the named factor replaces its fixed value.
The common single-factor base setting is 80 A, 26 cm/min, 3 Hz and 3 mm.
The current/speed/frequency/amplitude layerwise sweeps use 60 s interpass cooling, consistent with the v12 layerwise figure protocol.
The processed layer table preserves row-level lineage to data/raw/layer_partial.csv so every geometry value and varied X value can be audited directly.

evidence_basis.common_base_setting: 80 A, 26 cm/min, 3 Hz, 3 mm from the supplied single-factor process-design records
evidence_basis.current_speed_frequency_amplitude_coolin: 60 s from the v12 layerwise figure protocol
evidence_basis.cooling_sweep: the cooling-time column is varied directly from the v12 layerwise table; the non-varied parameters use the common single-factor base setting
